subject: StellarOps MSA/DPA/SOW - commercial scope & redline alignment
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@stellarops.com>

Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@stellarops.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@stellarops.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StellarOps redlines (MSA / DPA / draft SOW)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Attaching our redlines for the MSA and DPA and a short draft SOW that reflects the phased connector work we discussed (pilot -> extend -> support). Highlights / asks from legal and procurement:

- Procurement needs a confirmed billing cadence (monthly vs. net-30) and approximate quarterly usage estimates for committed capacity.
- Legal pushed back on your standard liability cap; they asked if we can align to 6 months of fees or $1M, whichever is lower.
- Data classification: StellarOps will be sending customer contact metadata; they requested stricter PII handling and a 90-day KV cache retention cap.

Files attached: StellarOps_MSA_redline_v3.docx, StellarOps_DPA_comments.xlsx, SOW-stellarops-integration.pdf

Can you confirm who we should expect to review these on the Redwood side and the expected timeline? We are hoping to finalize by the end of next week.

Thanks,
Maya Gupta
Legal Lead, StellarOps Consulting

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@stellarops.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarOps redlines (MSA / DPA / draft SOW)

Hey Maya —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear notes. Looping in Sergio (legal) for the contract/legal questions and Vanessa (partnerships/ops) for billing and SOW timing. Initial responses below so you have visibility while we do a formal pass: 

- Billing cadence: we can accommodate monthly billing; net-30 payment terms are standard for customers of your size (we can confirm with finance).
- Liability cap: Sergio, is there flexibility on the 6-months-of-fees / $1M ask? Our default is 12 months / $2M.
- KV cache retention: we have a configuration knob — 90-day retention for KV/prefix cache is acceptable for dedicated connectors with data processing controls; need a DPA note.

We will aim to return a consolidated redline + companion note by Thu Apr 8. If that works for StellarOps we can schedule a short call Thu morning to walk the items that need tradeoffs.

Note: attaching internal pointer doc to track the redline items for vendor ops (not included in external thread).

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@stellarops.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarOps redlines (MSA / DPA / draft SOW)

Maya / team —

Thanks for the redlines. I did an initial pass and have three core items that we should either negotiate or present as non-starters. I captured these inline in the MSA doc (attached) but summarizing here: 

1) Liability cap: we are generally able to be flexible for strategic partners, but lowering to 6 months / $1M materially increases commercial risk. Proposed compromise: 9 months / $1.25M and carve out gross negligence/intentional misconduct from the cap.

2) Data retention / cache: Redwood supports a 90-day KV cache cap for dedicated/private deployments; for hosted integrations we require an exception workflow. If StellarOps needs hosted model variants, we will require a SOC2 scope addendum.

3) Indemnity / third-party claims: StellarOps requested vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims tied to customer prompts; we cannot accept a broad indemnity tied to user-generated prompts. We can accept a limited indemnity for claims stemming from our deliverables or willful misconduct.

I propose a 30-minute legal sync Thu Apr 8 9:00–9:30 PT to align on the above. Vanessa — can you confirm billing cadence implications and whether committed quarterly usage estimates are required to secure pilot capacity?

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the run rates and commitment note — that helps a lot. Confirming next steps and outcomes from our side ahead of today's legal call at 9:00 PT:
